## ecommerce_category_banner

> Wide 16:9 storefront category banner with a row of product silhouettes, headline, sub-text, and CTA.

**Artifact:** `poster`, `1920x1088`, aspect `16:9`
**Demo vars:** `templates/ecommerce/_vars_examples/ecommerce_category_banner.yml`

### English

```
[1. Subject] A wide 16:9 storefront category banner for the Spring Outdoors category, themed around early spring. The composition shows a relaxed horizontal row of three to five product silhouettes from the category, anchored on the left by a stacked headline / sub-text / CTA group, against a backdrop pulling its tone from the sage and clay palette.
[2. Action] The eye enters at the headline, scans rightward across the row of products, and resolves on the CTA button. The banner must read as a single still hero — no in-banner motion, no carousel arrows, no "scroll right" affordance. It teases the category, it does not transact.
[3. Scene] Studio storefront stage: a soft graduated backdrop in the sage and clay family, with a quiet floor shadow under each product silhouette. No human models, no real architecture, no seasonal clutter; the early spring mood is conveyed through palette and lighting alone.
[4. Composition] Horizontal 16:9 frame. Left ~36% holds a vertical text stack: large category headline at top, a single line of sub-text beneath, and a rounded-rectangle CTA button below that. Right ~60% carries the product silhouette row, products evenly spaced with consistent floor-shadows and matched scale. A 4% gutter separates the text column from the product row. Generous safe area top and bottom.
[5. Style] Editorial storefront aesthetic — a step calmer than promotional sale art. Palette anchored on sage and clay with one warm neutral and one charcoal for type. Type system: geometric sans- serif headline (weight 700), lighter weight on the sub-text. Matte materials, no gloss, no glitter, no neon. CTA carries a single accent color drawn from the palette family.

Text to render exactly (chunked into named slots):
- category_title: "Spring Outdoors"
- sub_text: "Lightweight gear for trail, river, and ridge."
- cta: "Shop the collection"

NO: human models, lifestyle photography, flash-sale price stickers, watermarks, lens flare, rainbow gradients, clip-art snowflakes or cartoon seasonal stickers, 3D chrome lettering, busy promotional badges
```

## ecommerce_marketplace_card

> Compact 1:1 marketplace tile — product, price, and a single trust badge — built for grid views.

**Artifact:** `poster`, `1024x1024`, aspect `1:1`
**Demo vars:** `templates/ecommerce/_vars_examples/ecommerce_marketplace_card.yml`

### English

```
[1. Subject] A compact 1:1 marketplace tile for Linen Crew Tee — Sand sold by Northwind Goods. The product sits centered against a clean off-white backdrop, with a small price tag and a single trust-style badge (Free shipping) anchored near the corner. Reads as one card in a 4-column or 6-column results grid.
[2. Action] The viewer's eye registers the product first, the price second, and the badge third — all within a single fixation. No carousel, no scrolling, no in-card animation; the tile must work as a thumb- scroll-stopping still.
[3. Scene] Studio marketplace stage: soft warm off-white backdrop, a faint floor shadow grounding the product, no environmental props. The vendor name appears as a small subdued line under the title — present but visually quiet.
[4. Composition] Square 1:1 frame. Top ~8% holds the product title in a single line. Central ~62% band shows the product silhouette generously padded. Bottom ~22% carries the vendor wordmark on the left, the price chip and trust badge on the right. Internal padding ~6% on all sides; the composition reads cleanly even at 240px thumbnail size.
[5. Style] Marketplace-grid aesthetic. Palette: warm off-white field, charcoal text, one quiet accent (signal blue or olive) for the badge. Type: geometric sans-serif at title weight 600, smaller weights for vendor and price. Matte surfaces, soft 1-pixel hairline rules, no gloss, no harsh shadows, no border outline around the tile itself.

Text to render exactly (chunked into named slots):
- title: "Linen Crew Tee — Sand"
- vendor_name: "Northwind Goods"
- price: "$38"
- badge: "Free shipping"

NO: lifestyle photography, human models, busy promotional banners, watermarks, rainbow gradients, clip-art icons, cluttered multi-badge stacks, lens flare, cartoon mascots
```

## ecommerce_product_hero

> Single-SKU hero card for a product detail page — large product silhouette, price tag, primary CTA.

**Artifact:** `poster`, `1024x1280`, aspect `4:5`
**Demo vars:** `templates/ecommerce/_vars_examples/ecommerce_product_hero.yml`

### English

```
[1. Subject] A vertical 4:5 product hero card for Apex Trail Runner Pro, presented as a single confident e-commerce listing image. The product itself is rendered large and centered, isolated cleanly against a flat color backdrop tinted with deep moss green, with a small price tag chip and a high-contrast primary CTA button anchored at the bottom.
[2. Action] The image must read instantly as "buy now": the eye lands on the product silhouette, drops to the price chip, then to the CTA. No motion suggestion, no in-use lifestyle scene — this is a pure listing card optimized for conversion at a glance.
[3. Scene] Studio-flat e-commerce stage: matte deep moss green backdrop with a very faint radial vignette behind the product to lift it from the field. No shelves, no people, no ambient props. A subtle floor-shadow grounds the product without implying a real environment.
[4. Composition] Vertical 4:5 frame. Top ~10% margin. Product silhouette occupies the central ~60% band, generously padded. Below the product, a small pill-shaped price chip sits ~6% above a wide rounded-rectangle CTA button (~80% frame width, ~9% frame height). Product name typeset above the product in compact title case. Safe area generous on all sides for marketplace edge-cropping.
[5. Style] Modern D2C product-card aesthetic. Palette anchored on deep moss green with a single neutral (charcoal or warm white) for type and one contrast accent on the CTA. Type system: a clean geometric sans-serif (Inter / Söhne family). Surfaces feel matte and quiet — no glossy chrome, no marketplace badges crowding the frame, no lens flare.

Text to render exactly (chunked into named slots):
- product_name: "Apex Trail Runner Pro"
- key_feature: "All-terrain grip, 280g per shoe"
- price: "$129"
- cta: "Add to Cart"

NO: lifestyle photography, human models, busy seasonal backgrounds, watermarks, retailer logos, lens flare, 3D extruded chrome buttons, rainbow gradients, cluttered marketplace badges
```
